edits.name: bell
edits.prompt: Repaint the first image as a royal court bell, seen exactly side-on, in exactly the hand-painted storybook style of the pieces in the second image: soft painterly gouache shading with gentle gradients, fine thin dark linework, warm natural wood. A carved wooden arch of two sturdy posts and a curved crossbeam, each end of the beam carved as a small crocodile head, teal cord lashings round the posts, little gold studs along the beam, standing on a plank foot; a shining bronze bell hangs from the middle of the beam on a short rope, warm gold highlights, a gold band round its rim, a clapper below. Keep its shape and size. Keep the flat plain grey background around it, with empty grey space on every side.

edits.name: courtFar

Soft dusk glow behind the island. The same flat dusky purple and orange silhouette style as the rest of the picture.
